sql: SELECT s.nume FROM studenti s, note n WHERE s.nr_matricol = n.nr_matricol(+) MINUS SELECT s.nume FROM studenti s, note n WHERE s.nr_matricol = n.nr_matricol(+) AND s.an = 3
SELECT s.nume FROM studenti s, note n WHERE s.nr_matricol = n.nr_matricol(+) INTERSECT SELECT nume FROM studenti WHERE an = 1
